title: Contact Cartographer
tagline: Arrange a chain reaction and trace how tiny contact estimates redirect motion.

paper.title: RiCo: Neural Simulation of Rigid-Body Interactions via Local Contact Reasoning

novelty: No known implementation (not verified): this demo fuses local-contact reasoning ideas with an editable chain-reaction puzzle and a coarse-response comparison.
description: An offline 2D collision puzzle that makes an approximate contact-to-motion trace visible. It is an educational illustration, not a physical simulator.
howItWorks: Three procedural convex polygons move under a bounded fixed-step impulse simulation. Local mode estimates a surface contact from polygon support points and applies an offset spin effect; coarse mode uses object centers and omits spin. The trace labels the contact approximation and resulting response.
controls: Drag bodies to arrange them and drag the lime handle to aim and set strength. Launch starts a run; Reset restores the preset; Replay repeats the last setup. Keyboard: focus the board, press 1–3 to select a body, arrows to move it, Shift+arrows to aim, and +/− to adjust strength. Toggle Coarse comparison to switch response modes.
